title: Vloer Run card theme, format v1
description: A declarative theme on top of a shipped skin pack. The schema states the shape; the skin's manifest further limits tokens, frames, foil patterns, art presets, art kinds and sound banks, and Vloer refuses any value its manifest does not list. See card-themes.md.

asset.description: A theme asset: the SHA-256 id Vloer answered when it was uploaded, or, for a theme in the mounted themes folder only, a file name in that folder's assets/ directory.

id.description: What a Work Target names as cardStyle.theme in Ploeg's configuration.

extends.description: The shipped skin pack the theme sits on: forge or vloer-native.

tokens.description: Custom properties the skin's manifest lists in themeTokens. Colours are hex; --gc-radius is whole pixels from 0 to 32. No other CSS is accepted.

frame.description: One of the skin's theme.frames (forge: classic, fullart, slab); null means classic.

foilPattern.description: One of the skin's theme.foilPatterns; null means a pattern picked per card. A pack pull still overrides it.

art.description: Exactly one of a preset from the skin's theme.artPresets, a shader asset or an image or video asset; null means art picked per card.

setSymbol.description: A sanitized SVG asset uploaded for the set symbol.

cardBack.description: A PNG, JPEG or WebP asset uploaded for the card back.

soundBank.description: One of the skin's theme.soundBanks. No shipped skin lists one yet, so it must be null or absent.
